answer: When k coordinated identities equivocate on correlated statements, pairwise evidence can trigger penalties across up to k(k−1)/2 relationships, making slashing O(k²), not a flat per-node fee. Bonded collateral escrows make each identity’s stake collectible; detection can apply an exponential multiplier to aggregate capital loss as the swarm grows, with asymmetric depreciation limiting recovery. This raises the cost of hiding a willow-like cluster beneath tundra-level participation while the protocol tracks its pulse.
